description:
`agent.push_probe` -- the credential-free first contact (spec §4.4).

Opens the transport, completes the key exchange, records the host-key
fingerprint and the banner, and closes. **It never authenticates, so it
presents no credential, and this model has no field that could carry one**
(falsifier 22). Exactly one target, SSH, or WinRM for Windows (Kerberos only) (§13).

dns_name.description: The target's DNS name. Required for `winrm` (Kerberos needs `HTTP/<fqdn>`, not an IP); unused for `ssh`. Optional on the wire so the field is additive.
dns_name.title: Dns Name

target_address.description: Exactly one IP literal. Never a CIDR.
target_address.title: Target Address

transport.description: `ssh` for Linux/macOS; `winrm` for Windows (Kerberos only). ADDITIVE: older control planes never send `winrm` and older agents never advertise the capability, so a mixed fleet is unaffected.
transport.title: Transport
